processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Minimal processing. Records remain in original file folders.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Collection contains the research files of John Z. Bowers including articles, manuscripts, notes, photocopies, and other background materials.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: This collection was donated to the RAC in 2008 by the Medical Center Archives of New York-Presbyterian/Weill Cornell.

bioghist.head: Biographical / Historical
bioghist.p: Historian and educator John Zimmerman Bowers served as president of the Josiah Macy Jr. Foundation of New York, which focuses its work in the areas of health and medicine. Prior to his service to the Macy Foundation, he was dean and professor of medical physics at the University of Utah and he also served the Ford Foundation primarily through work in India. After Bowers service to the Macy Foundation, he was a consultant for the Rockefeller Foundation for which he compiled a history of their health and natural-science programs in 1983.

Bowers authored or edited several major publications and essays including but not necessarily limited to: "Western Medical Pioneers in Feudal Japan" (1970), "When the Twain Meet: The Rise of Western Medicine in Japan" (1981), "Advances in American Medicine" and "Science and Medicine in Twentieth-Century China" (1989).
